Intentions for the Week

Intentions for the Week- Week 46 in 2026

Listen to audio version of this article

Instaread

Hi friends! Happy Monday! How was your weekend? Did you get some self-care in?  We got a lot done around the house this weekend. Got rid of a bunch of stuff and took it all to the dump!  WHAT A RELIEF TO BE FREE OF THINGS THAT NO LONGER SERVE US. I also checked in with my plants, had a art date with HJH via Zoom, and hosted Self Check In! I also caught up on my planners. 

My new cover for my 2027 Hobonichi arrived! I’m excited to get into it!

 

Also, I am sending out a bunch of mail today! Thanks for your orders. 

New product alert!

Want to process the year? I made us a little workbook that will help. 

Save the date: Saturday 12/12, I’ll host a Zoom where we can work on it together. I’ll have more information soon/signup available soon. 

This is the perfect way to transition into the new year with a Currently Workbook! 

If you want to join in the fun, you can get a Currently Workbook here!  And if you’re international, Blurb can send you one. Here’s the link for international shipping, 

In case you missed it, I posted the recipe for this Smoked Trout dip last week.  It’s the perfect addition to your holiday festivities!

Those are my Intentions for the Week! 

Feeling stuck? Make a list! Write down your intentions for the week to help hold you accountable for action.

My Intentions for the Week printable might help you! It definitely helps me.  

Better yet, get yourself an Intentions for the Week Planner!  You can start at ANY time since you fill it in as you go. If you need extra support getting your week ahead together, I host Self-Check-In every Sunday morning that will help. 

I’m rooting for you!

Wishing you a productive week. Take good care of YOU!
